response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of the role, particularly in C++ on Windows and capital markets/fixed income domain expertise. His background in web, mobile, and embedded systems, while impressive, does not sufficiently address the specialized needs of this position.
strengths: Extensive experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, showcasing adaptability and technical breadth.
Strong communication skills and a proven track record of knowledge sharing through workshops and talks.
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and contributions to developer tooling and infrastructure.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last noted in 2015) and no explicit mention of Windows platform development.
No evident experience in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income domains.
Primary expertise lies in full-stack web and mobile development, which diverges from the role's focus on low-latency, high-performance financial systems.

key_factors.factor: Domain expertise in capital markets/fixed income
